title: A boundary integral equation method for Steklov eigenvalue problems for smooth planar domains
summary: In this paper, we present a novel numerical method for computing the Steklov spectrum of bounded and unbounded simply connected planar domains with smooth boundaries. For the unit disk, the Dirichlet-to-Neumann operator can be written explicitly in terms of the classical conjugation operator. We extend this framework to general simply connected domains by expressing the Dirichlet-to-Neumann operator in terms of the generalized conjugation operator, which is defined via the boundary integral equation with the generalized Neumann kernel.
